prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: I have studied English for five years.
I have study English since five years.
I studied English for five years ago.
I am studying English since five years.
answer: I have studied English for five years.

現在完成式要用 have + 過去分詞 studied；since 後接時間起點，不接一段時間。
ago 表示過去的某個時間點，不能和 for 一起用。
since 搭配現在完成式，不用現在進行式；且 since 不接 five years。

why: for + 一段時間，搭配現在完成式表示從過去持續到現在。
tip: for + 一段時間；since + 起點。
say: I have studied English for five years.

prompt: 口說測驗時，考官問你週末做什麼。你想說「我通常在家看書或打籃球」。哪一句最自然？
options: I usually read books at home or play basketball.
I usually reading books at home or play basketball.
I am usually read books in home or play basketball.
I usual read books at home or playing basketball.
answer: I usually read books at home or play basketball.

wrong.I usually reading books at home or play: usually 後面是一般動詞，不能用 reading，要用原形 read。
wrong.I am usually read books in home or play: am 與 read 同時出現造成兩個動詞；at home 才是固定說法，不是 in home。
wrong.I usual read books at home or playing ba: usual 是形容詞，修飾動詞要用副詞 usually；or 前後也要一致用原形。

why: 習慣用現在簡單式，副詞 usually 放在動詞前，or 連接的動詞形式要相同。
tip: or 前後的動詞形式要一致。
say: I usually read books at home or play basketball.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: If it _____ tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.
options: rains
will rain
rained
is raining now

wrong.will rain: if 引導的條件子句用現在式表示未來，不能再加 will。
wrong.rained: 過去式用於與現在事實相反或過去發生的事，這裡是對明天的真實條件。
wrong.is raining now: now 表示此刻，與 tomorrow 衝突。

why: 真實條件句：If + 現在式, will + 原形。
tip: if 子句用現在式，主句才用 will。
say: If it rains tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.

text: He is not only a good teacher but also a kind friend.
options: 他不但是好老師，也是親切的朋友。
他不是老師，而是一位好朋友。
他是好老師，所以沒有朋友。
他只想當朋友，不想當老師。
answer: 他不但是好老師，也是親切的朋友。

wrong.他不是老師，而是一位好朋友。: not only ... but also 是「不但……而且」，兩件事都成立，不是否定老師身分。
wrong.他是好老師，所以沒有朋友。: 原句沒有因果關係，更沒有說他沒有朋友。
wrong.他只想當朋友，不想當老師。: 句子描述他的身分與特質，沒有表達意願。

why: not only A but also B 表示 A 和 B 都成立。
tip: not only A but also B：兩者都有。
say: He is not only a good teacher but also a kind friend.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: The book which I borrowed from the library is very interesting.
The book which I borrowed it from the library is very interesting.
The book what I borrowed from the library is very interesting.
The book I borrowed from the library are very interesting.
answer: The book which I borrowed from the library is very interesting.

wrong.The book which I borrowed it from the li: which 已經代表 the book，再加 it 就重複了受詞。
wrong.The book what I borrowed from the librar: what 不能當關係代名詞修飾前面的名詞，要用 which 或 that。
wrong.The book I borrowed from the library are: 主詞 book 是單數，be 動詞要用 is。

why: 關係代名詞 which 已經取代受詞，所以後面不再重複 it；主詞單數用 is。
tip: 關係代名詞已當受詞，不要再加 it。
say: The book which I borrowed from the library is very interesting.

prompt: 短文翻譯題：你要把「我寧願在家看電影，也不想出去逛街」翻成英文。哪一句最好？
options: I would rather stay home and watch a movie than go shopping.
I would rather to stay home and watching a movie than go shopping.
I prefer stay home watch a movie than going shopping.
I would rather staying home to watch a movie than to go shopping.
answer: I would rather stay home and watch a movie than go shopping.

wrong.I would rather to stay home and watching: would rather 後面直接接原形，不能加 to，and 後面也要保持原形 watch。
wrong.I prefer stay home watch a movie than go: prefer 後面要接 to V 或 V-ing，且比較時不用 than 接 going，結構混亂。
wrong.I would rather staying home to watch a m: would rather 後面不能接 -ing，than 前後的結構也需要一致。

why: would rather + 原形 + than + 原形，結構平行。
tip: would rather 後面直接接原形。
say: I would rather stay home and watch a movie than go shopping.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: The speaker was so _____ that everyone in the hall understood her ideas easily.
options: articulate
arrogant
ancient
anxious

wrong.arrogant: arrogant 是「傲慢的」，無法解釋聽眾為什麼能輕鬆理解。
wrong.ancient: ancient 是「古老的」，不能形容講者的表達能力。
wrong.anxious: anxious 是「焦慮的」，焦慮通常不會讓大家更容易聽懂。

why: 大家容易理解，表示講者表達清楚，articulate 是善於表達的。
say: The speaker was so articulate that everyone in the hall understood her ideas easily.

prompt: 申論題寫作：哪一句最適合用來表達個人立場？
options: In my opinion, students should be allowed to use phones to learn.
In my opinion, students should allowed to use phones to learn.
In my opinion, students should be allow to use phones to learn.
According to my opinion, students should be allowed use phones to learn.
answer: In my opinion, students should be allowed to use phones to learn.

wrong.In my opinion, students should allowed t: should 後面缺少 be，被動語態要寫 should be allowed。
wrong.In my opinion, students should be allow: 被動語態要用過去分詞 allowed，不是原形 allow。
wrong.According to my opinion, students should: according to 用於引用別人的說法，個人立場用 in my opinion；allowed 後面也缺少 to。

why: In my opinion 表達個人立場，be allowed to + 原形是被動語態。
tip: 個人立場用 In my opinion，不用 according to。
say: In my opinion, students should be allowed to use phones to learn.

text: Her speech was brief, but it left a lasting impression on the audience.
options: 她的演講很短，卻給聽眾留下深刻印象。
她的演講很長，讓聽眾感到無聊。
她的演講沒有人聽，所以很快結束。
她的演講很短，所以聽眾都忘記了。
answer: 她的演講很短，卻給聽眾留下深刻印象。

wrong.她的演講很長，讓聽眾感到無聊。: brief 是「簡短的」，不是長；lasting impression 也是正面評價。
wrong.她的演講沒有人聽，所以很快結束。: 原句說對聽眾有影響，表示有人聽，沒有暗示沒人聽。
wrong.她的演講很短，所以聽眾都忘記了。: but 表示轉折，後面說的是留下持久的印象，不是忘記。

why: brief 是簡短的，but 後面是轉折，lasting impression 是深刻持久的印象。
tip: lasting impression = 深刻持久的印象。
say: Her speech was brief, but it left a lasting impression on the audience.

prompt: 口說測驗中，你沒聽清楚考官的問題，想請他再說一次。哪一句最自然？
options: Sorry, could you say that again, please?
Sorry, you say again that, please?
Sorry, I no understand your question.
Sorry, please you repeat to me.
answer: Sorry, could you say that again, please?

wrong.Sorry, you say again that, please?: 語序混亂，請求要用 Could you ...? 的禮貌問句。
一般動詞的否定要用 don't understand，而且這句沒有請求對方再說一次。
please 的位置不自然，repeat 後面也不需要 to me。

why: Could you say that again? 是最常用的禮貌請對方重複的說法。
tip: 沒聽清楚：Could you say that again?
say: Sorry, could you say that again, please?

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: _____ the heavy rain, the baseball game went on as planned.
options: Despite
Because of
Due to
Thanks to

wrong.Because of: because of 表示原因，但大雨不是比賽照常進行的原因，語意相反。
wrong.Due to: due to 也是表示原因，與「照常進行」的轉折關係不合。
wrong.Thanks to: thanks to 表示「多虧」，用來說好的原因，不適合形容大雨。

why: 大雨與比賽照常進行是讓步關係，despite 表示儘管。
say: Despite the heavy rain, the baseball game went on as planned.
